dev.envMissing: Supabase keys are missing. Copy .env.example to .env and fill it in. Backend calls are disabled.

screens.comingSoonBody: This screen is not built yet. It arrives in phase {{phase}} of the build plan.

pwa.installBody: Add it to your home screen for a full-screen app and faster access.
pwa.installIosBody: Tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Start your 14-day free trial. No card needed.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick something you haven't used before.
reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to finish setting up your account.
verify.wrongEmail: Wrong email? Sign out and start again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your business
onboarding.subtitle: This takes a minute. You can change everything later.

hints.branchName: Leave blank to use your business name.
hints.currency: Used on this location's invoices. It cannot change once invoices exist.
hints.timezone: Appointment times at this location use this.
hints.country: Sets tax rules and SMS rates for this location.

errors.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only
errors.slugReserved: That address is reserved. Please pick another.

onboarding.locationIntro: These settings belong to this location. If you add more locations later, each one can have its own country, currency and timezone.

noAccess.title: You do not have access to this page
noAccess.description: Your role does not include this area. Ask an owner or manager if you need it.

empty.title: No team members yet
empty.description: Invite the people who work with you so they can take bookings.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.subtitle: They get a link that works for 7 days.
invite.roleHint: You can only grant permissions you have yourself.
invite.linkOnce: Copy it now and send it to them. It is shown only once and works for 7 days.

accept.title: Join the team
accept.invalid: That invite link is not valid. It may have expired or already been used. Ask for a new one.
accept.joinAs: You have been invited to join {{business}} as {{email}}.
accept.createFor: You have been invited to join {{business}}. Create your account for {{email}} to continue.
accept.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your address, then open the invite link again.
accept.wrongAccount: This invite is for {{invited}}. Sign out and sign in with that address to accept it.

locked.title: Your trial has ended
locked.trialEnded: Your 14-day trial is over, so this business is paused. Get in touch and we will set up a plan for you.
locked.suspended: This business has been paused. Get in touch and we will help you sort it out.
locked.dataSafe: Nothing has been deleted. Your bookings, clients and invoices are all still here.

schedule.dateFormatHint: Use the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-25.
schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.breaksHint: Breaks sit inside the working day, like a lunch hour.

timeOffEmpty.title: No time off booked
timeOffEmpty.description: Holidays and days away will show here.

schedule.branchHoursHint: When this branch is open. Staff hours sit inside these.

holidaysEmpty.title: No closures
holidaysEmpty.description: Add days the branch is shut.

schedule.resourcesHint: Rooms, chairs or bays. These are saved now but do not affect bookings until the booking engine arrives.

resourcesEmpty.title: No rooms yet
resourcesEmpty.description: Add rooms, chairs or bays if bookings need one.

empty.title: No services yet
empty.description: Add what you sell so customers can book it.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this service?
deleteConfirm.message: It will be hidden from new bookings. Past appointments and invoices keep it.

fields.name: Name
fields.categoryHint: Optional. Groups services on the booking page.
fields.bufferHint: Clean-up time before the next booking.

errors.durationTooShort: A service must be at least 5 minutes
errors.durationTooLong: A service cannot be longer than a day
errors.categoryNameTooLong: That category name is too long

empty.title: No staff yet
empty.description: Add the people who provide your services.

deleteConfirm.title: Remove this staff member?
deleteConfirm.message: They will be hidden from new bookings. Their past appointments stay.

fields.emailHint: For your records. It does not create an app login.

errors.jobTitleTooLong: That job title is too long
errors.phoneTooLong: That phone number is too long

bookingPublic.noStaff: Nobody is available for online booking yet.
bookingPublic.noSlots: No times available. Try another day.
bookingPublic.anyStaffHint: We will assign whoever is free.

form.name: Your name
form.phoneHint: So we can confirm your booking.

bookingPublic.confirmAuto: The customer is told their booking is confirmed straight away.
bookingPublic.confirmManual: The customer is told their request was sent and is waiting for you to confirm.

bookingSettings.title: Booking settings
bookingSettings.subtitle: How online booking works for this location.
bookingSettings.previewHint: What your customers see. Sample times.
bookingSettings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
bookingSettings.onlineBookingHint: Turn this off to stop taking new online bookings. Existing bookings are not affected.
bookingSettings.staffChoiceHint: Whether customers pick who they see.
bookingSettings.staffChoiceHiddenHint: Customers do not choose. We assign whoever has the fewest bookings that day.
bookingSettings.staffChoiceOptionalHint: Customers may pick a person, or choose "Any available person".
bookingSettings.staffChoiceRequiredHint: Customers must pick a person before they can book.
bookingSettings.slotDisplayAvailableHint: Only times that can be booked are listed.
bookingSettings.slotDisplayGreyedHint: Booked times are shown crossed out, so customers can see how busy you are.
bookingSettings.confirmationManualHint: Bookings arrive as requests and hold the time until you approve them.
bookingSettings.showPricesHint: Display each service price on the booking page.
bookingSettings.requireEmailHint: Name and mobile number are always required. Email is the only one you can change.
bookingSettings.slotIntervalHint: How often a booking can start. "Service length" starts them back to back.
bookingSettings.minimumNoticeHint: How soon before a slot a customer may still book it.
bookingSettings.bookingWindowHint: How far into the future the booking page shows.
bookingSettings.customerCanCancelHint: Lets customers cancel or move their own booking from the link we send them.
bookingSettings.cancelCutoffHint: After this, they have to call you.
bookingSettings.useResourcesHint: Only offer a time when a required room is also free.
bookingSettings.peoplePerSlotHint: More than 1 lets several customers book the same time, for a class.

bufferExplain.none: No gap is added after a booking.
bufferExplain.branchOnly: Every service gets this gap after it.
bufferExplain.serviceOnly: Only the services with their own gap have one. Others have none.
bufferExplain.serviceOverridesBranch: A service with its own gap uses that instead of this one — they are not added together. For example a 10 minute gap here and 15 minutes on a service means 15 minutes, not 25.

bookingSettings.linkHint: Share this with customers, or put it on your social media.
bookingSettings.linkNotReady: This link will work once the warnings above are fixed.

warning.no_branch_hours: Set your opening hours first. Without them the booking page has no times to offer.
warning.no_bookable_service: Add at least one service that can be booked online.
warning.no_bookable_staff: Add at least one person who can be booked online.
warning.no_staffed_service: You have services and people, but nobody is assigned to a bookable service yet.
warning.booking_disabled: Online booking is turned off for this location, so the link will not take bookings.
warning.buffer_override: Some services have their own gap, which replaces the one set here.

error.forbidden: You do not have permission to change booking settings.
error.unknown_branch: This location could not be found. Try reloading.
error.invalid_value: One of the values is out of range. Check and try again.
error.peopleConflictOne: Cannot reduce to {{limit}}: one upcoming time slot already has {{booked}} bookings ({{service}} at {{time}} on {{date}}). Those bookings keep their place — reduce this after they have passed, or cancel one.
error.peopleConflictMany: Cannot reduce to {{limit}}: {{count}} upcoming time slots already have more bookings than that. The busiest is {{service}} at {{time}} on {{date}} with {{booked}}. Those bookings keep their place.

bookingFields.fixedHint: These are part of every booking and cannot be removed.
bookingFields.phoneLockedReason: We match returning customers by their number, so it is always required.
bookingFields.versionNote: Changes apply to new bookings only. Past bookings keep the form they were made with.
bookingFields.empty: No extra questions yet. The booking form asks only the fields above.
bookingFields.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
bookingFields.archivedHint: No longer asked. Past answers are kept.
bookingFields.archiveConfirmBody: It will stop appearing on the booking form. Answers already given are kept and stay readable.
bookingFields.label: Question
bookingFields.typeLocked: The answer type cannot change once a question is saved. Add a new question instead.
bookingFields.helpTextHint: One line shown under the question. Optional.
bookingFields.requiredHint: Customers cannot finish booking without answering.
bookingFields.sensitiveHint: Only people with permission to see sensitive client details can read the answers.
bookingFields.sensitiveLocked: Once a question is marked sensitive it stays that way, because answers were given on that basis.
bookingFields.sensitiveConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. Every answer already given to this question becomes sensitive too, and only staff with permission to see sensitive client details will be able to read them.
bookingFields.allServicesHint: Turn off to ask only for certain services.

validation.helpTooLong: Keep the help text under 300 characters.
validation.optionsTooFew: Give at least 2 choices, one per line.
validation.optionsDuplicate: Two choices are the same. Make each one different.
validation.servicesRequired: Pick at least one service, or ask for every service.
